Lena (People Ops): Quick run-through needed. Manager wants an out-of-cycle title bump + comp change for an IC (SWE -> Senior SWE). Effective 2026-05-01. What are the minimum docs we need to get payroll and equity aligned?
Raj (Eng Manager): Submitted manager note & updated job profile. Candidate is internal, so no external offer. We want base from 130k -> 145k, plus small one-time RSU top-up. Need to confirm retro behavior.
Dawn (Comp): For internal promos w/ comp increase: comp approval ticket required (we'll issue CC-OC-2026-05-02). Attach manager justification + 2 internal benchmarks. For RSU top-up label as OFFCYCLE_ONE_TIME and include vesting schedule.
Ellen (Payroll): Payroll needs Workday change ID, eff_date, and a CSV to ingest. If approval is after payroll cutoff (monthly cutoff 2026-04-30 23:59 PT) we'll process a single retro payment on the next posting. If you want to avoid a retro, state that explicitly and have comp sign off.
Lena (People Ops): What columns should the CSV have exactly?
Ellen (Payroll): CSV columns: employee_id, name, old_annual, new_annual, eff_date, comp_ticket, approver, equity_action, notes. Example row:
```
22440,Jordan P,130000,145000,2026-05-01,CC-OC-2026-05-02,Dawn M,"OFFCYCLE_ONE_TIME:300, vesting:4y,cliff:1y","Manager: scope growth"
```
Dawn (Comp): Note on bonus eligibility: base changes mid-year get target pro-rated from eff_date for THAT cycle. If you want to change the bonus target classification, that needs separate comp approval.
Raj (Eng Manager): Understood. For communicate to the IC: should we say "effective May 1, retro expected if approved after payroll cutoff"?
comp-approval-bot: Reminder: please attach benchmark spreadsheet and manager calibration note to ticket CC-OC-2026-05-02. Comp committee triage SLA: 48 hours.
Lena (People Ops): We'll aim for comp ticket today. One nuance: finance asked whether off-cycle RSU requires finance sign-off if above $X. Is that true?
Dawn (Comp): Yes — any one-time equity > $15k (current valuation) needs finance approval. Add finance_approval_email link in the comp ticket.
Ellen (Payroll): Also FYI: backpay will be taxed in the pay period where it posts; the payslip will show two lines (retro and current). Optionally include a short comms note to the employee explaining the separate line.
Raj (Eng Manager): Good to know. Last Q: if comp approves but the manager wants to delay base increase one pay period to avoid two different gross amounts, is that allowed?
Dawn (Comp): Allowed if manager provides written justification and employee signs acknowledgement. Comp prefers retro when effective date represents actual work performed.
Lena (People Ops): Perfect. I'll open CC-OC-2026-05-02, attach docs, and post the Workday change ID + CSV here once ready. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
